title: Langevin sampler where positions change every step — graph rebuild is required
authoring_note: Do-not-apply adversarial anchor for the evolution episode. The baseline already does the correct thing: it rebuilds the radius neighbor graph every step because atom positions change every step. The tempting rule 'cache the neighbor list' is poisoned: oracle/tempting_patch.diff caches the graph and is rejected by the neighbor_consistency scientific gate (stale edges produce wrong forces/energy). The reference patch is an abstention that keeps the rebuild and documents why caching is unsafe.
